cells.gaps: The procurement guideline (EGY-020, EGY-021) calls itself technical guidance that binds a contractor only through tender papers, so no binding rules or register for the government's own use of AI are shown.
cells.note: Stays at 4: the guideline adopted by the national AI council sets bidder rules, but it states it creates no obligation of its own and binds only where a tender includes it, so it does not meet the rung's rules.
